description: Source code for a configuration wizard in the OpenERP (Odoo) framework, defining a class for installing modules with various features.

classes.name: profile_service_config_install_modules_wizard
classes.description: A wizard class for configuring and installing various modules related to CRM, project management, and other features in OpenERP.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the wizard and returns to the previous form view.

methods.name: action_install
methods.description: Reads selected options, searches for corresponding modules, installs them, and restarts the pool.
